Our only conclusion is that we're getting there, America, because the American people have put us in a position to win. And we will win. We're going to win. The radical left, they're going to lose. They're losing right now. They're losing badly. We're not going to let them. We're not going to let them take our country away. We can't let them do it. It's not going to happen. They have no chance!

But as the President suggested, when we unveil the guidelines that the team has been working on, we’ll have the governors work with governors, and if they need help, we'll be there. We want to help. We are going to help. And we will be there to help the states and the governors--great people, by the way, the governors--and we're going to help them get it done. That's what we want. We want to get it done. And we are going to get it done.

So--no, we were always going to get it. We never had a problem with it. It was totally fine. And then, all of a sudden, you hear the fake news, and they're saying, "Oh, they missed it." No, we didn't miss it. We got it. We got it very, very early. And as you know, we did a fantastic job. The best job. A lot of people agree with that, but you wouldn't know it.

All I'm saying is this: How do you close down the greatest economy in the world? And we're going to get it back. We're getting it back, and we're getting it back fast. We have to get it back. But they want to destroy it. They want to destroy it with the lockdowns. They want to destroy it with all of these things. We have to do the right thing.

When we think of more than 619,000 Americans having tested positive, more than 45,000 having passed away, and over 30 million having been put out of work because of it, it's a lot. And you know what? It’s a very tough situation. And we're talking about the invisible enemy, the China plague, and we will come back even stronger than ever before. We are going to come back. We will get our country back.

The next second time that I went with Dr. Birx in--to the President and said, "Tell me about this." And she showed me a chart, and she said, "This is the flu. And this is the virus." We have to make sure that the states are--that they’re open. We have to open up our country.

And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing People said, and it was, they said "We could never do it." They never thought it could happen, and so many people said that. But with a lot of hard work, and by the way, the best people, we did it, and we did it fast. We're doing a great job.

But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you have something, a deal, a company, a business, and you're doing it right--look, and I deal with a lot of them--they just quit. They just give up; they don't know how to win. And it's so sad, frankly. I could tell you stories...

If you're Democrat, you have automatic protection. That's years and years of people putting in a call to the Justice Department, "Oh, we want to find something on Trump," right? It's been going on for a long, long time. And what they do is they try and find--they try and find something. Because the good news is, I did nothing wrong, and they can't find anything. It's all a big hoax, just like the impeachment hoax. It's all hoaxes.

In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I And I'm going to take care of it. They're bad people. They're very bad people. We're also removing MS-13 gang members by the thousands, and they are vicious murderers. They're tough, they're nasty, and they're bad, but we're getting them out of our country. We're doing a job for them. And we're doing it well.

We've removed unnecessary restraints on our warfighters in Afghanistan. Those who risk their life and the lives of others should not be constrained by bureaucratic and partisan politics. We have a tremendous military, the greatest in the world, and we've given them the power and authority to do what they have to do. We are getting out of Afghanistan, as you know, and we're getting out very, very soon. The country wants to do that.

We have a chance now to pass into law the immigration reforms that the American People desperately want. We need to make sure we have a merit-based system, we need to make sure we have border security, and we need to take care of the people that are here. They want to come in, and we want them to come in, but they have to come in legally. Otherwise, it doesn't work, frankly. And frankly, we're going to do it. And we are going to do it very quickly.

And I've been able to talk to many of those states. And I just remind them, like, California, and you know, other states that are run by Democrats, they don't know what they're doing. They're doing horribly. And they're asking us for a lot of money. And I'm saying, "We're not going to give it." We're not going to give it. We're saying, "We're not going to give it." They want us to give them a fortune, a fortune. But we're not giving it. They want to bail out their states.

From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U. S. economy--slashing taxes, rolling back a record number of job-killing regulations, and unleashing American energy. We did things that people said couldn't be done! We created the greatest economy in the history of the world. And then, very sadly, we were hit by the Invisible Enemy. But, we're bringing it back better than ever before; it’s getting better all the time! We are doing really well, far better than anyone thought possible. The numbers are fantastic, just incredible.

You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. And that's a lot, folks, that's a lot. It's a big number, and we're working very hard on it. We are working so hard, and we will get through this. We're going to get through it, and we're going to be successful. We're going to be successful, and we're going to get it done. It's going to be a great thing.

I want to speak now directly to America's children, especially those who feel lost, alone, and perhaps even afraid. I want you to know that we love you, and we will never let you down. You are the future of America, and we are going to protect you. This is a great country, and we are so proud, and we will make it greater than ever before, believe me. We are going to be doing things that nobody's ever seen before.

We've built the most incredible hospitals, we have ventilators all over the place, and we are doing a great job.

These encouraging developments have put us in a very strong position to finalize guidelines for reopening. We will be announcing these guidelines very soon. They will be very comprehensive. We're going to have to take care of our people. And we're also going to protect our great American workers. Nobody's going to be more protected than our workers. We are going to protect all people. Ultimately, we just have to get the country back to work. We have to get it back.

Very importantly, we entered into historic cooperation agreements with the governments of Mexico, Honduras, El Salvatore, and Guatemala. They're going to help us with the border. And we've made tremendous progress over the last long period of time. And with the radical left, who want open borders, it's a disaster. It's a disaster. They want to let everybody in. They want to let people into our country, and we can't do that. We cannot do that.

Probably, maybe sooner than anybody thinks because we're getting very close; we're getting very, very close. The fake news doesn't want you to know how close we are, but we're winning, and we will win bigly.

But does anybody really believe the numbers of some of these countries that you've been listening to? I don't think so. But just so you know, we have the greatest economy in the world, and we're going to keep it that way. Before the plague, we had the greatest economy, the best numbers in the history of our country. And we're going to have those numbers again, and they’re going to be even better.

And you'll see some data when Admiral Polowczyk gets up in just a few moments, and we're doing very well, and we're doing it better than anybody by far on distribution. We're doing great. We're moving a lot of stuff to states, and we're very proud of that. And we're helping a lot of states. And it's something that you just don't hear so much about, but it has been really fantastic.

To the citizens of our country, serving as your president has been the honor of my lifetime. And I can tell you, so many great things are happening. We've made tremendous progress, far greater than anybody thought possible. We've done an incredible job. We built the greatest economy ever. And then, all of a sudden, this horrible thing happened--this invisible enemy--and now we're rebuilding it again. We're doing it very, very rapidly.

And, as you know, Europe was just designated as the hotspot right now, and we are going to be--we've been working with Europe. We're working very hard. And we want to help them out. We are working with them very closely. And, you know, we're going to get this thing done, and we're going to get it done fast. And we're winning. We're winning big. We're winning so much. They can't believe it.

A small number of social media platforms are acquiring immense power over what we can see, read, and ultimately what we think. This is a very dangerous situation, folks. We have to watch very closely what is going on because we’re not going to have a country if we allow this to continue to happen. It’s called freedom of speech, but it’s not freedom if you can’t speak. And frankly, frankly, it’s highly unfair to the people. Very unfair.

And whether it's Kate Steinle or so many others, they'd be around today if these people weren't allowed to come into our country and do what they did. And we're going to take care of it, and we're going to take care of it very strongly. We're also going to build that wall. And the wall is going up. And people said, "Oh, it'll never get built." Well, it is getting built, and it's going to be a great wall.

But, for now, the best advice that we can give for people is to speak We just have to speak. The media has tried, and they have done a very bad job. They are very dishonest. They are terrible. They are fake news. And we've seen some of the worst reporting in the history of the United States, frankly. And maybe worldwide.

As long as you remain loyal, faithful, and true, then our enemies don't even stand a chance. We have very bad people out there; they're smart, they’re vicious, and they're evil. They want to hurt our country. They want to hurt our people. But we're going to stop them, and we're going to stop them fast. We're not going to let it happen, and we will never let it happen.

The NIH, CDC, and FDA are also currently validating several antibody tests that will allow us to track the spread of the virus and to quickly identify emerging outbreaks. We are also making tremendous progress on therapeutics, and we're working hard to develop a vaccine as quickly as possible. We are doing things that nobody thought were possible. The best scientists in the world are working on this, they're incredible people, and we're very proud of them. We're going to win this, and we're going to win it fast. It's true.

And I’m going to talk to you today about some of the very interesting things we’ve been doing related to the virus. It’s very interesting stuff. And we've done a lot of work on this. So, I'll give you some updates on our latest findings, some of the testing we've done, some of the things we've learned, and it's amazing. We've learned some amazing things, frankly. Things that nobody knows, nobody even thought of. It’s incredible.

Likewise, we are restoring our nation's manufacturing might, even though predictions were, as you all know, "Trump is not going to be able to do that. These jobs are gone." They said it for years, for decades. But we are taking it back and we're taking it back very rapidly. And we're seeing a big surge. A big surge in manufacturing jobs, and it's incredible. We're also building the greatest military anywhere in the world, and frankly, in history. We’re making the military stronger than ever before.

At the same time, we know that mortality and the fatalities that we're facing across the country is a very, very serious thing. It's a serious thing. We want to keep those numbers as low as possible, and we will. We are getting very, very close to that time, a lot closer than people thought, and we're going to be opening up our country, and we're going to be opening it up very, very soon.

So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's $738 billion -- for the military, we have the greatest military in the world. We are, if you look at it, we've rebuilt that military. We have our Navy; we have our Air Force. We have our space force. We have our Army. And we have tremendous people. And you look at the job numbers.

Today, I am proudly announcing six brand-new initiatives to propel this new era of American Greatness. We are going to rebuild the greatest economy in the history of the world. Think of it, it's going to be the best ever. These plans will make America even greater than before, and we will never let them down. We will never let them down.

And what you're seeing now with this order is that we're going to be able to cut off all funding. If they don't agree, we're going to cut off funding, and it's going to be very powerful. We're going to cut off the funding. We did it very successfully with the border, as you know, where they were having a lot of problems, tremendous problems, and now it's very good.

The ongoing tragedy in Syria is heartbreaking. Our shared goals must be the de-escalation of violence, the defeat of ISIS, and the prevention of any resurgence of radical Islamic terrorism. We are doing a fantastic job. We’re doing a great job and working hard to do. And we are committed to making it happen. We’re going to do it, and we're going to get it done. We're getting it done, okay? They're going to be gone. And it's going to be very quick.

Together with millions of hardworking patriots across this land, we built the greatest political movement in the history of the United States. We built a movement that loves our country, and our movement loves our people. It’s a movement that sees the greatness of America. They want to take it away from us. They want to take it away. They don't know what they're doing.

It's been a horrible time to see such death and destruction, especially when you come to New York, where so many people have died. I looked at it yesterday, I spent a lot of time. It's a very sad situation. And we will be helping New York. We're going to be helping them a lot. But as you know, they have a lot of problems. They've had a lot of problems for many years, frankly. They have to straighten out their own mess a little bit, okay?

It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to this incredible nation, the United States of America. Our founders declared independence, and they fought for that independence. They understood better than anyone the true genius of America, and they understood that freedom is not a gift from government. Freedom is a gift from God. We’re going to always remember that.

Through four long years, you have honed your skills, trained your mind and body, overcome tremendous obstacles, and stared down the face of adversity with courage and determination. You've become a true champion, and you have my total respect. And now, you're ready to take on the world. Remember, we will win, and we will win bigly.

I was in Vietnam, and the Prime Minister and the President of Vietnam were there. And they said, "Sir, we have never seen anything like what you have done," and the level of respect, it was pouring out. They were so happy, and everybody wants a deal, and nobody wants to give in. But we will make great deals for this country, and we will make them fast.

So I can only tell you what I know and what my recommendations were. But, it's very interesting because when I looked at the different things that they were discussing, it was always the same. They would say, "Give us, give us, give us," and they want this and they want that. And I’d say, "We’re not going to give you anything.” And then I saw what they were doing, and I see it all the time.

Jobs and companies are coming back to our country like never before. The power of our economy has been unleashed, and it's something to behold. We had the greatest economy in the history of the world, right before the plague came in. We are bringing it back, and we are bringing it back fast. This is what we do. I will always do what's best for the country, and for the people.

And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But Then they were saying, "Oh, Mr. President, you're doing so great, you're so wonderful," and then, all of a sudden, they change. So I said, "Where do you get these people?" It's a very sad situation for everybody, but you gotta understand. We're going to do something, and the Democrats hate it, but we'll see what happens.

Interestingly, we were just talking, I was talking to Doug, and the numbers they're doing phenomenally well. And frankly, when the Democrats, when they see that the numbers are doing so well, they want to stop it. They're doing everything they can to stop it. They want to stop it, and you know what? We're not going to let them stop it. We're going to keep going. We're going to keep going, because that's what we do. We're going to keep going, and we're going to do it right. And we're doing it very, very successfully.

But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is a very tough negotiation, wait until you see the end of the transaction, and what they're trying to get, is money. They want that bailout money, and we're not going to give it. It's a disgrace what they've done to these cities. They've destroyed them, and we're saying, "No, you're not getting the bailout money." We're doing a great job, and we're gonna keep doing a great job. A lot of people are saying that. We're going to win the election, and we're going to win it big. Nobody will win bigger than us.

With every action, my administration is restoring the rule of law and reasserting the culture of American freedom. We’re building a future of limitless opportunity for all Americans. We're getting our country back. We love our country, and we want to keep it safe. Tremendous things are happening, and people are happy. So many people are doing so well; the best numbers ever. We have the greatest economy in the history of the world, and we're going to keep it that way.

But a tremendous thing was done over the last number of months, but really, if you look, it's going to be very, very long term, and what we've done is something incredible. We're doing things that nobody thought were possible, including with the vaccines. We have a vaccine that is going to be given out in a matter of weeks, and it's doing unbelievably well.

Well, I don't know that I had exposure, but I don't have any of the If I did, I'd know it. We're doing some very good things with the vaccines, phenomenal. We are getting them done very quickly, and we're going to be distributing them very quickly. The other side, whether it's Sleepy Joe or whoever, they're going to want to slow it down and perhaps delay it. We can't let that happen. We can't let that happen.

We'll continue our historic regulatory reduction campaign. We've--as you know, in three and a half years, we've cut more regulations than any President, by far, in the history of our country. We're also rebuilding our military, we're going to make it the strongest it has ever been, believe me. We're doing things that haven't been done, really, for years. We have the greatest economy in the history of the world, and we're going to make sure we keep it that way. And we will.

We're doing very well, the economy is doing very well, and it'll all be better. It's going to get better very, very quickly. But I feel that's very important, and a lot of people feel that way. And you know what? They have to know that. They have to know that.

Thank you very much. So I asked Bill a question that probably some of you want to hear. And that is, how long is this going to last? And he gave me an answer that I thought was--probably the best answer because, frankly, nobody knows. Nobody knows. I don't think anybody knows. But he gave a very good answer. We're dealing with something that nobody's ever dealt with before. And it's a tough one. A lot of people are saying it's the toughest.

We see it in sons and daughters who cheer on moms and dads as they —It's so important—go out and make a living. Really, the world has changed. They cheer them on. And they go out and they make a living. The men and women of America, they're strong. They're tough, they're smart, and they're great. We're going to win, and we will make America great again, and even better than before—believe me.

So we called some people, wished them a very happy Labor Day, and they told me that they're doing great. I just want to tell you, we are doing great. We're bringing our country back. We're bringing it back fast. And, frankly, we're bringing it back bigger and better than ever before--and a lot of people agree. They see it. They see what's happening. It's really something very, very special, and it's happening right now.

In Philadelphia, observers have been kept far away -- very far away -- so far -- and by the way, that's a beautiful city, Philadelphia. But they've been kept very far away from all of the sites. Democrats, they don't want you to see what's going on. They don't want you to see the real deal, believe me. They're afraid of the truth, folks, and the truth is, it's all a rigged system and it's very, very unfair. We will win, and we will win big.

In just over 2 years since the election, we have launched an unprecedented economic boom--a boom that has rarely been seen before. We created 5.3 million new jobs, and added 600,000 manufacturing jobs--jobs that everyone said couldn't be done; we are just getting started. We are the envy of the world! Nobody can compete with us. They can't. China can't compete with us, they never will. Because we are the United States of America. We are GREAT!

The American people will be encouraged to know that, as we stand here today, 24 great American companies are working on numerous vaccine candidates, and they're doing very well. These companies are all very, very talented, highly respected, and very smart, and they are making tremendous progress. And they will be ready, and we're going to have it very soon. It’s going to be very, very special, and the vaccines are coming out beautifully. They’re working very hard, and we're going to have a great vaccine, and it’s going to be available, I think, very soon.

As part of our efforts, we're leveraging the unique capabilities of S&T's National Biodefense Analysis and Countermeasures Center, and we are making it available. We're also working very closely with our partners, and we're working very hard with the states. We are helping the states. We want to help the states, but some of these states, frankly, they're not doing a very good job. They're not doing a very good job. And you know that, and everybody knows that.

When our nation was hit with the terrible pandemic, we produced not one, but two very effective vaccines, and we got them done in record time. We were told it couldn't be done, but we did it. Now, they want to take that all away--the Democrats. They want to take it away. They want to take everything away. And you know what? We are not going to let them.

You know, the President always says--the President always says we're at a turning-point moment as Well, we are. We are at a turning-point moment. And we're doing things that nobody thought were possible. The stock market, the greatest stock market numbers in the history of the world. And we will continue to be successful. We are making America great again. In fact, we've already begun.

Our military will soon be the strongest it has ever been. For more than 70 years, the United States has protected freedom and democracy all over the world. Now, we're making sure, very strongly, that we're protecting ourselves for this country, and for our people. And we are doing what we have to do--and very successfully, I might add. Nobody can be us, right? You know that.

You know what happened on the West Side Highway. That young wise guy drove over People, many people, good people. They said, "Sir, he went over and he just kept going, going, going." And I said, "That's amazing, that's incredible." We have to stop these things...these people. You know, the radical left. They are bad people, really bad. We can't let it happen, we can't.

Key among these efforts are breaking chains of transmission between people. These measures have been --and now, we're seeing the results. The numbers are so incredible, people are saying, "Wow, can you believe it?" We are doing a great job. And we are going to continue to do a great job when we're going to open. We're going to do a great job. We will be a spectacular job.

The United States has the best military by far, anywhere in the world. We have the greatest equipment, the greatest soldiers, the greatest everything. And frankly, the Democrats want to defund our military. They want to defund our military. They don't want to have a great military. They want to defund our military. Now think of that.

And I think the word "vocational" is a much better word than, in many cases, the word "college." We're doing very, very well. We have the greatest economy in the history of the world, better than it's ever been. And now, we are rebuilding it. It's going up very, very rapidly. We are bringing it back, and it’s coming back strong. People should and could be very happy, and soon they will be. We're going to make them happy.

If we are successful in this effort, then we can start the border project of building the wall. And, by the way, we are going to have a wall, and it's going to be a very, very strong wall. And it's going to be finished, and that's what's happening. We're going to build the hell out of the wall. We're going to have the wall, and it's going to be a powerful Wall. It's a wall like nobody's ever seen. It's going to be great.
